items.sectionInstructionKo: [18–19] 다음 중 <보기>와 밑줄 친 현재완료의 의미가 같은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
<보기> The speech contest has just started.
① We have already taken the class.
② Brian has studied in the library for two hours.
③ I have practiced swimming since I was a child.
④ The boy has never forgotten his mother's birthday.
⑤ She has lost her cell phone, so she has to buy a new one.
choices: We have already taken the class.
Brian has studied in the library for two hours.
I have practiced swimming since I was a child.
The boy has never forgotten his mother's birthday.
She has lost her cell phone, so she has to buy a new one.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [20] 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① She expected us <u>to arrive</u> on time.
② You told him <u>to be</u> quiet in the library.
③ Tom had his younger brother <u>move</u> the boxes.
④ Kate wanted me <u>to remember</u> the password.
⑤ The teacher got me <u>to hand in</u> the test.
choices: She expected us <u>to arrive</u> on time.
You told him <u>to be</u> quiet in the library.
Tom had his younger brother <u>move</u> the boxes.
Kate wanted me <u>to remember</u> the password.
The teacher got me <u>to hand in</u> the test.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [21] 다음 중 <보기>와 문장 구조가 같은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
<보기> She sent a letter to her husband.
① Those flowers look very beautiful.
② I cooked fried rice for my parents.
③ Few people found the man honest.
④ The police ordered him to stand still.
⑤ Can you pass me the pen on the desk?
choices: Those flowers look very beautiful.
I cooked fried rice for my parents.
Few people found the man honest.
The police ordered him to stand still.
Can you pass me the pen on the desk?

items.sectionInstructionKo: [22–23] 다음 문장을 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn:
She bought her daughter a warm coat.
= She ______ her daughter.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [22–23] 다음 문장을 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn:
The famous writer will publish a science fiction novel next month.
A science fiction novel ______ by the famous writer next month.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [24] 주어진 문장을 수동태로 바꿔 쓰세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn: I can fix your computer. (수동태로)
accept: Your computer can be fixed by me.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [25] 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
• The movie is known (A) ______ its shocking ending.
• The doctor ordered him (B) ______ a healthy diet.
① of — follow
② of — to follow
③ for — to follow
④ for — following
⑤ with — to follow
choices: of — follow
of — to follow
for — to follow
for — following
with — to follow

items.sectionInstructionKo: [26] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 대화를 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① A: When shall we meet tomorrow for our group project?
B: Linda will let us know the schedule.
② A: Did the package arrive on time?
B: No, it didn't. It is being delayed.
③ A: What were you doing last night?
B: I was watching TV with my brother.
④ A: Do you want to play soccer today?
B: It may rain soon. Let's do it tomorrow.
⑤ A: Nick, can you lend your science book me?
B: Sorry. Hojin has already borrowed it.
choices:
A: When shall we meet tomorrow for our group project?
B: Linda will let us know the schedule.

A: Did the package arrive on time?
B: No, it didn't. It is being delayed.

A: What were you doing last night?
B: I was watching TV with my brother.

A: Do you want to play soccer today?
B: It may rain soon. Let's do it tomorrow.

A: Nick, can you lend your science book me?
B: Sorry. Hojin has already borrowed it.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [27] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
ⓐ Jimmy made the boy angry.
ⓑ Jake has made these cookies yesterday.
ⓒ Would you like a cup of tea?
ⓓ She is really satisfied with her new car.
ⓔ The woman felt someone to touch her shoulder.
ⓕ You should to bring an umbrella. It is raining.
① ⓐ, ⓒ
② ⓑ, ⓔ, ⓕ
③ ⓐ, ⓓ, ⓔ
④ ⓒ, ⓓ
⑤ ⓑ, ⓓ

items.sectionInstructionKo: [28] 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 서로 다른 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① My sister helped me make dinner.
= My sister helped me to make dinner.
② Mark Twain did not write this novel.
= This novel was not written by Mark Twain.
③ Did your sister invite Brian to the party?
= Was Brian invited to the party by your sister?
④ The train is delayed, so I don't have to run to the station.
= The train is delayed, so I shouldn't run to the station.
⑤ Before the injury, I could run 5 miles every morning.
= Before the injury, I was able to run 5 miles every morning.
choices:
My sister helped me make dinner.
= My sister helped me to make dinner.

Mark Twain did not write this novel.
= This novel was not written by Mark Twain.

Did your sister invite Brian to the party?
= Was Brian invited to the party by your sister?

The train is delayed, so I don't have to run to the station.
= The train is delayed, so I shouldn't run to the station.

Before the injury, I could run 5 miles every morning.
= Before the injury, I was able to run 5 miles every morning.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [29] 다음 대화에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분 두 군데를 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요. 어법에 맞지 않은 부분을 고친 말만 쓰세요.
items.promptEn:
틀린 두 곳을 위에서부터 고친 말만 쓰세요.
A: I really love the Harry Potter series. I'm having the whole series at home.
B: Oh, really? I like them a lot, too. Can I borrow them tomorrow?
A: Of course. You can to visit my house tomorrow.
B: Thank you. When should I give them back?
A: Anytime. Those copies have been read many times already.
